== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Wyron Serper (Japanese)|Wyron Serper]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/156433110/Du68IIeGG0ixvhkar38SIg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 89232348.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>b79c6e1ea20d1a9e39390222bc99cb98f42ac55fdffe9cf9343d084ff38fe55c</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
